rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card, synthetic validation (exactness and planted-cycle power), four replication periods and two natives, frozen guarded confirm script; holdout not run.
rationale.faithfulness: The first-order picture (self-catalysis 0.85-0.99, no supported cycles, cycles below the rewired null in G51, NE29 null) holds in all periods. The pre-registered coverage bound and time arrow fail, and coverage rests on a head-only execution rule (0.3-14% without python). C = 1, D = 1.
rationale.usefulness: A clear negative for the egregore reading and a simple audit rule (list self-writing streams per repo), but no lever; the catalysis edge is not causal at session level.
